info.title: Scholar AI API
info.description:
Scholar AI backend API.

Auth bodies use JSON with snake_case field names (`full_name`, `email`, `password`). Protected routes require an application Bearer token from `/auth/login` or `/auth/google`.

get.description: Counts all managed accounts, including admins and users without profiles. Active means is_active=True; suspended_users counts the existing inactive state (False or legacy NULL). New users are counted by created_at within the current UTC calendar month. Counts are independent of table filters.

get.summary: List users for admin user management
get.description: Search account names, profile names and email; filter by role and account status. Newest registrations first by default, with ID as a stable tiebreaker and unknown dates last. Missing profiles and avatars are supported.

patch.description: Requires an active admin. Accepts student or admin and returns the updated User Management row. Changes only role, preserving account status and all other user data. Self-demotion is forbidden; redundant changes return 409. Existing cookie/Bearer tokens use the current database role on each request.

403.description: Requires active admin; self-demotion is forbidden

409.description: User already has the requested role

422.description: Invalid user ID, role or extra request fields

patch.summary: Suspend or reactivate a user account
patch.description: Requires an active admin. Accepts active or suspended and returns the updated User Management row. For compatibility, suspended is returned as account_status=inactive. Admins cannot suspend themselves. Repeating the current status returns 409. Suspension blocks login and existing tokens on subsequent protected requests.

403.description: Requires active admin; self-suspension is forbidden

409.description: User already has the requested status

422.description: Invalid user ID, status or extra request fields

get.description: Counts existing scholarships across all sources. Weekly counts run from Monday 00:00 UTC through now. Approval uses the latest approval audit date, falling back to reviewed_at for legacy records. Reviewed means currently approved or rejected with reviewed_at this week. Missing source URLs are counted across all statuses. Undated reviews are excluded from weekly counts.

get.summary: List scholarships for review by status
get.description: Paginated manual listings and listings from for9a and ministry, filtered by status (pending by default). Accepted statuses are pending, approved and rejected. Ordered by scraped_at descending (unknown dates last), then id descending. Requires an admin.

Returns unreviewed pending manual listings and listings from the for9a and ministry scrapers, newest scraped_at first (unknown dates last), then highest id first. Total counts all matching listings before the limit. Requires an authenticated admin.
Counts pending and approved (published) scholarships and all users, including administrators and inactive accounts. Requires an authenticated admin.

Returns the last 12 UTC calendar months, oldest first, including the current month and zero-activity months. Counts currently approved scholarships by reviewed_at, falling back to scraped_at when review dates are missing, and all users by created_at. Undated records are excluded. Requires an admin.
Returns the count of unread notifications for the admin notification bell counter. Requires an authenticated admin.

post.description: Rejects/archives a scholarship with a mandatory reason. Saves rejection reason, admin ID, rejection timestamp, and generates an administrative audit log. Prevents re-rejecting already rejected scholarships (409 Conflict).

post.description: Creates an unverified user and sends a verification OTP. Fields: `full_name`, `email`, `password`.

JSON body with `email` and `password`. On success, sets a secure HttpOnly cookie containing the JWT access token. Returns only the user role in the response body — the token is NOT exposed to the frontend.

403.description: Account disabled or email verification required

get.description: Returns id, email, name, and role for the currently authenticated user. Authentication is read from the HttpOnly session cookie (set by /auth/login). Falls back to Authorization: Bearer <token> for API/test clients.

post.description: Verifies a Google OpenID Connect ID token. On success, sets a secure HttpOnly cookie and returns the user object. The JWT access token is NOT included in the response body.

503.description: Google login unavailable or database error

400.description: Old password is incorrect or new password is identical

post.description: Clears the HttpOnly session cookie. Safe to call even if the user is not currently authenticated.

post.summary: Report a problem with a scholarship
post.description: Allows an authenticated student/user to report an issue with a scholarship (e.g., broken_link, expired, duplicate, suspicious, incorrect_information, other). Requires an active account. Checks scholarship existence, including expired or no-longer-visible listings, without returning scholarship details. Description is optional (maximum 2000 input characters); outer whitespace is trimmed and blank text becomes null. The reporter comes from authentication. An existing report of the same type by this user for this scholarship blocks a repeat only while unresolved (pending). Resolved or dismissed reports allow immediate resubmission.

409.description: This user already has an unresolved report of this type for this scholarship

422.description: Invalid scholarship ID, report type, description, or extra fields
